purpose: Extend the topology/motion trade-off curves to convergence budgets; measured, not assumed.

reporting.selection_rule: Report every checkpoint. Prefer Pareto-nondominated topology/motion checkpoints; ties break earlier.
reporting.claim_limit: One training seed per arm and one fixed evaluation seed set support checkpoint diagnosis, not a convergence law. The fresh 100k run is not the 20k run resumed; same-step milestones need not match.
